MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The CA glue fits my use of tapes and epoxy for DIY assemblies, giving me another way to make quick bonds on small parts.",
    "The gloves would help with messy adhesive work, and the magnets offer removable attachment options for workshop fixtures and craft assemblies. Both support the hands-on work reflected in my recent purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The rain barrel spigot assumes a plumbing project I have not shown a need for; buying tools and fasteners does not mean I currently need water-container fittings.",
    "The appliance cleaner, tourniquet bracelet, and anatomy models do not help with the fastening, fabrication, and repair tasks I am browsing for.",
    "The pocket hole screws, construction adhesive, and hex bolts are plausible supplies, but I would need a specific joint, mounting job, or bolt length before choosing them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical tools seems to have been stretched into an interest in unrelated household, emergency, and educational supplies.",
    "My repeated fastener purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to suggest more screws and bolts without enough attention to whether their dimensions and intended uses fit my next job."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My rivet tool, rivet nuts, drilling supplies, and measuring tools point toward making and fitting assemblies, where compatible threads, dimensions, and materials matter.",
    "I already have several fastener assortments, so another pack needs to fill a clear gap. A complementary supply such as quick-bonding glue or removable magnets gives me a clearer reason to try it.",
    "An item can fit my repair interests without being something I need now; heavy construction adhesive and a particular bolt length depend on the project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my hands-on assembly interests but stretched them too broadly and missed some project-specific compatibility and timing needs."
}
